final_response.answer: For a data‑science focus, look at STAT 5114 (Statistical Inference, avg GPA 3.87), STAT 5525 (Statistical Learning, avg GPA 3.88), and STAT 5054 (Intro to Statistical Computing, avg GPA 3.89); the other two courses (STAT 5034 and STAT 4004) also cover inference and computing fundamentals with solid averages (3.77 and 3.86).
